metadata.case_name: KWOK KWAN LAM v. LAI PO SING AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: multiple fractures of all 5 metatarsal bones of the left foot
source: Dr. Chan Wai To of Tuen Mun Hospital stated in his report dated 13th September 2010, on initial admission to the A&E Department, the Plaintiff was found to have tenderness over right chest wall, an open wound and multiple fractures of all 5 metatarsal bones of the left foot. The Plaintiff was admitted to the orthopaedic ward for further treatment.
